title: Jam Tiga Belum Pulang
subject: dugem sampai pagi karena nggak mau pulang
caption: Funkot crossed with trap and a koplo break. Relentless 180 BPM funkot kick, a chopped and pitched female vocal sample as the melodic hook, sudden halftime koplo kendang break in the middle, distorted bass, sirens used sparingly. Shouted male rap with a flat aggressive delivery. 182 BPM, F minor. Exhausted euphoria. No clean EDM build, no supersaw drop, no quantised MIDI kendang, no melodic autotune hook.
lyrics:
[Intro - funkot kick alone]

[Hook - chopped sample and shouted]
Jam tiga belum pulang
Jam tiga belum pulang
Bukan karena seru
Karena kosan gue sepi

[Verse 1 - shouted rap]
Temen gue udah pulang jam satu, dia ada anak
Gue nggak ada apa-apa, jadi gue masih di sini
DJ-nya ganti, orangnya ganti, gue nggak ganti
Gue yang paling lama di ruangan ini, termasuk yang kerja

[Instrumental Break - koplo kendang, halftime]

[Verse 2 - shouted rap]
Besok Sabtu, gue nggak kerja, itu alasan gue
Minggu gue juga nggak kerja, itu masalahnya
Senin gue interview, ketiga bulan ini
Gue nggak mikirin itu sekarang, itu gunanya jam tiga

[Hook - chopped sample and shouted]
Jam tiga belum pulang
Jam tiga belum pulang
Bukan karena seru
Karena besok juga sepi

[Outro - kick stops dead]
[Song ends abruptly]
